description: Regularized incomplete beta function I_x(a, b) = B(x; a, b) / B(a, b)

tolerance.reason: I is the prefix x^a (1-x)^b / (a B(a, b)) times a well-conditioned series or continued fraction. On this grid the logarithms of the prefix's factors reach 2.8e4 in magnitude (a = b = 1e4) while their sum stays above -745; forming them separately in double precision loses up to 2.8e4 * 2^-53 (about 3e-12), and combining them before rounding (Boost's Lanczos-based prefix) loses far less. 1e-12 demands the careful approach and is 6x the worst SciPy error on this grid (1.6e-13)
